visual.name: CustomSlicer
visual.description: Custom slicer which will display the Manufacturer by Sales of Top “N” products and categorize the rest as “Others”. This is a common need in business reporting.

multiselect.description: Filter multiple items at a time

topelements.description: Show top N number of Elements

fixedelements.description: Show fixed elements. Please provide categories as comma separated values

licence.description: Enter the licence key to use the premium features
